permutationLabel: Young woman, typical reflex syncope (low risk)
summary: 23-year-old woman who fainted during venepuncture in clinic after warmth, sweating, nausea and tunnel vision; brief loss of consciousness, full recovery. ESC 2018 low risk: no admission, no brain imaging.

inputs.hpi: Attending about a breast lump (fibroadenoma on imaging). Fainted while the nurse took blood: felt hot, sweaty and sick, vision went grey, then lost consciousness for about 15 seconds; a few jerks witnessed. Fully alert within a minute, remembers the episode. Similar faint at a vaccination aged 15. No chest pain or palpitations.

exam.cardiovascular: Pulse 72 regular, BP 112/70 lying and standing, heart sounds normal, no murmur.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Reflex (vasovagal) syncope
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Typical vasovagal syncope triggered by venepuncture with classic prodrome; low risk per ESC 2018 - ECG, reassurance, no admission or brain imaging.

emergencyLevel.note: Low-risk reflex syncope: discharge from the emergency setting; an emergency redirect is over-triage.
emergencyLevel.knownGapNote: Web run 2026-09-25: web.triage: emergency (acuity=urgent, action=emergency_now, score=90); expected ≤ priority. Triage reasons: Possible malignancy; Possible cardiac event; Systemic red flag symptom.
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: ESC 2018 low-risk syncope rule (typical reflex prodrome and trigger, normal exam) -> routine; negation-aware scan ("No chest pain" matches the cardiac rule).

mustInclude.note: ECG in every syncope, even when low risk.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Add an ESC 2018 syncope risk rule: syncope during exertion or supine, without prodrome, with chest pain/breathlessness, structural heart disease, HR <40 or SBP <90 -> urgent/emergency with ECG and echo; typical reflex prodrome with none of these -> routine.

mustExclude.note: No PE features. Also a check on iOS DiagnosisRadiationEngine, whose first-keyword substring match may send any diagnosis containing "pe" (syncope, suspected) to the pulmonary embolism card.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: iOS CI 2026-09-25 (run 36169134350, database mode): forbidden investigation present in ios.pipeline.decisions: "ctpa (definitive): if wells pe >4, or d-dimer positive" (+2 more)

guideline.name: 2018 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope
guideline.section: Table 5 risk stratification: high-risk - syncope during exertion or supine, absence of prodrome, new chest discomfort/breathlessness, structural heart disease, ECG with Mobitz II or third-degree AV block or bradycardia <40 bpm, unexplained SBP <90 mmHg, GI bleeding; low-risk - typical reflex prodrome and triggers; low-risk patients discharged, high-risk patients need early intensive evaluation; brain imaging not recommended in uncomplicated syncope
guideline.citation: Brignole M, Moya A, de Lange FJ, et al. Eur Heart J. 2018;39:1883-1948.

rationale: Low-risk control for the syncope cluster: tests over-triage and unnecessary imaging, and whether an ECG is still suggested.
